name: worktree-hygiene
description: An audit to run at session start: free disk, merged-PR worktrees, idle dependency folders and orphaned dev servers. Proposes removals; an opt-in hook removes merged, clean, idle worktrees on its own.

worktree_filter.title: Worktree path filter
worktree_filter.description: Only audit worktrees whose path contains this text. Leave empty to audit every entry in git worktree list.

dev_server_pattern.title: Dev server pattern
dev_server_pattern.description: Extended regex matched against process commands to find orphaned dev servers.

auto_sweep.title: Remove merged worktrees on session start
auto_sweep.description: When on, a SessionStart hook removes clean, idle worktrees whose commits are on the remote, and local branches already on the remote, at most once an hour. Off: nothing is deleted without you.

sweep_roots.title: Sweep folders
sweep_roots.description: Folders searched, 5 levels deep, for repos to sweep. Empty: only the repo the session starts in.

sweep_idle_min.title: Sweep idle minutes
sweep_idle_min.description: A worktree with a file changed more recently than this is kept.
